name: ABE Equipment
old_description: At ABE Equipment, we pride ourselves in offering complete turnkey solutions for our customers. We don’t just sell products; we sell solutions! Sure, we design and assemble brewhouses, canning lines, distillation equipment, and more – but we craft each piece of equipment with the end goal in mind, which is designing a product that will help you make money. Our turnkey brewing systems and turnkey distillery offerings allow you to hit the ground running and focus on profits, not scrambling to source equipment from various vendors. When you choose ABE Equipment as your beverage equipment manufacturer, you’ve partnered with an international company backed by 30+ years of rich history. At ABE, we provide our clients with the opportunity for success by developing lasting partnerships. We are fully invested in your business’s growth from the initial startup to your equipment’s ongoing maintenance. You can always count on us to provide the equipment, services, and expertise you need to succeed.
about:
ABE Equipment is headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska. The company traces its roots to Norland International, a turnkey beverage equipment supplier with nearly three decades of experience. In 2020, the business rebranded from American Beer Equipment to ABE Beverage Equipment, and in 2022 shortened its name to ABE Equipment to reflect a broader market focus beyond beverages. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The company designs and assembles complete beverage production systems, including brewhouses, canning lines, distillation equipment, cellar tanks, filling machines, keg cleaners, labelers, and auxiliary packaging items. Operations are housed on a 140,000‑square‑foot campus that encompasses fabrication, production, warehousing, and support functions. A staff of 135 includes degreed electrical and mechanical engineers, a ten‑person customer service team that also serves as training technicians, and sales personnel with a combined 80 years of industry experience.

ABE serves craft beverage producers across categories such as craft beer, craft spirits, kombucha, cider, cold‑brew coffee, seltzer, infused beverages, craft soda, and wine. Customers range from startup entrepreneurs to established businesses expanding production capacity. The company positions itself as a single source for turnkey solutions, custom engineering, startup assistance, and ongoing parts support.

ABE emphasizes a service‑driven differentiator: its customer service representatives double as training technicians, ensuring hands‑on knowledge of both equipment and processes. Free equipment layout services, in‑house engineering, and a large parts warehouse are cited as key advantages. Core values highlighted by the company include adaptability, dedication, integrity, reliability, and respectfulness.
